title: Patterns in psychopathology of autoimmun psychoses
summary:
Background: Schizophrenia affects approximately 0.8% of the world's population. The causes of this and other psychiatric disorders are not yet fully understood. It is known that autoimmune processes can also lead to similar symptoms.

Research Question:
This study will use retrospective data analysis from the autoimmune diagnostics to investigate whether the symptoms of patients with abnormal autoimmune diagnostics differ from those of patients with normal autoimmune diagnostics.

Methods:
Data from the period 2015–2025 will be analyzed qualitatively.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all psychiatric patients who underwent serum/cerebrospinal fluid autoimmune analysis between 2015 and 2025. Cases with abnormalities (specific antibodies/positive screening) are compared with cases without abnormalities.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Abnormalities in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in autoimmune diagnostics / Control group: Serum and CSF unremarkable.
Exclusion criteria:
without
